Getting started

EVE-Cyno Data answers EVE Online questions with deterministic data and calculations: static-data lookups, fit validation and statistics from the Gofa dogma engine, live market prices, sovereignty and system activity, and a community-fit search. No language model is in the loop: the same input gives the same answer, and every answer names its sources.

Ask on DiscordBack to top

Choose how to connect#

Three doors, one service. They reach the same tools under the same tiers and limits.

recommended Claude Code plugin Two commands. MCP server, the eve-data skill and three slash commands. Any MCP client One URL, streamable HTTP: data.example.test/v1/mcp. REST & OpenAPI POST /v1/tool/{name} with the arguments as JSON.

Make your first call#

Ask for the Jita price of Tritanium (type ID 34). get_market_price is public: no key, no account.

$ curl -s https://data.example.test/v1/tool/get_market_price \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"type_id": 34, "type_name": "Tritanium"}'
import httpx

r = httpx.post(
    "https://data.example.test/v1/tool/get_market_price",
    json={"type_id": 34, "type_name": "Tritanium"},
)
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json()["result"]["text"])
// Node 18+ or another server runtime: the API sends no CORS headers.
const r = await fetch("https://data.example.test/v1/tool/get_market_price", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ type_id: 34, type_name: "Tritanium" }),
});
console.log((await r.json()).result.text);
> What is Tritanium selling for in Jita?

Read the answer#

REST wraps every tool answer in the same envelope:

200 · application/json
{
  "tool": "get_market_price",
  "version": "sha-aa76146",
  "result": {
    "text": "Market data (The Forge / Jita) — type_id=34:\nBest sell: 3.89 ISK  (41 orders)\nBest buy:  4.00 ISK  (63 orders)",
    "data": {
      "type_id": 34,
      "region_id": 10000002,
      "market": "The Forge / Jita",
      "best_sell_isk": 3.89,
      "sell_orders": 41,
      "best_buy_isk": 4,
      "buy_orders": 63
    }
  },
  "attribution": [
    {
      "name": "ESI (EVE Swagger Interface)",
      "url": "https://esi.evetech.net/",
      "license": "EVE Developer License Agreement (Fenris Creations); non-commercial use"
    }
  ]
}

Example from the live service on 2026-10-09; live ESI values change.

tool
The tool that answered.
version
The build of the service.
result.text
The answer as the chat assistant reads it.
result.data
The typed result where the tool has one, otherwise null.
attribution
The upstreams behind the answer: name, url, license.

Show the attribution

Keep the source and its licence wherever you show the data. Community fits carry their own attribution object with the author and a link: keep those too. See Attribution & licences.

Limits in one line#

Requests are limited per caller (per API key when one is sent, otherwise per client IP) over a sliding window; a refused request is a 429 with Retry-After. The numbers per route are on Access tiers & rate limits.

Tip

31 tools are public; one needs a free API key. Without a key the API is for trying it out; a free key is for connecting it to Claude Code, your own model or a bot (how to get one).
